resources.string: Your Phone. Your Voice. Your Intelligence.
Open apps and reach Android settings with your voice.
Press to talk · On-device recognition mode
Press to talk · Android speech provider
Speech detected. Tap Finish speaking to end the capture.
Speak now. Stop cancels without acting.
Use Edit to pin an action to Home.
Voice and text run through the same Android action engine.
Pick a phrase to fill the input. Nothing runs until you submit it.
Matching your request to a supported action.
No command was detected. Try again or type it.
That command is too long. Use at most 240 characters.
This version runs one action at a time. No action was taken. Try a single command.
I didn’t find a supported action in that request. Nothing was run. Try an example from Actions.
I sent Android the request to open %1$s.
Android couldn’t find an available app to open %1$s.
Keep VOICE OS open on screen to run the command.
Android didn’t return a battery percentage on this device.
Android couldn’t complete the request for %1$s.
The current operation was cancelled before handoff.
Microphone permission is off. Enable it in Permissions or use text.
On-device recognition isn’t available here. Use text or choose the Android speech provider in Settings.
Android has no available speech recognition service. You can still type commands.
No clear speech was detected. Try again somewhere quieter or type your command.
Listening timed out. Press the mic to try again.
This recognizer can’t use the selected language right now. Check the device language packs or type your command.
The Android speech service is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
Android couldn’t capture microphone audio. Check that the mic isn’t blocked, or use text.
The Android speech service returned an error. Try again or type the command.
An offline voice is available for this locale.
An offline voice in the same language is available, but its accent can be different.
No installed offline voice for this language. Responses stay visible as text.
Android text-to-speech isn’t working right now. Responses stay visible as text.
Tap to run or say the example. Apps and panels depend on what’s available on your device.
Launch only. VOICE OS doesn’t send messages, place calls or control app content.
Opens each settings screen without changing any values.
Manage what stays on your phone and how VOICE OS works.
View, edit or delete your display name.
See real outcomes and clear activity.
Choose the actions pinned to Home.
Manage microphone access and review the speech provider.
VOICE OS remembers only the profile detail you choose to save.
Your display name appears in the Home greeting. It’s optional and isn’t sent with commands.
Use up to %1$d characters with no control characters.
The secure store couldn’t complete the request. Try again or remove the local name.
Saved on this phone and encrypted with Android Keystore.
This version doesn’t learn from your conversations or access your contacts.
Remove your saved display name from this phone? Settings and history won’t change.
Up to %1$d recent results, newest first.
Results appear after you run a command or shortcut.
Matched actions can be saved on this phone. Raw commands and audio aren’t written to the log.
New results stay in this session only. Previously saved entries remain until you delete them.
Local history couldn’t be read or updated. Check your device storage and try again.
Delete the current conversation and the saved action log on this phone? This can’t be undone.
Choose the built-in actions that appear on Home.
Press a shortcut to run it. Nothing is scheduled or runs in the background.
Unpin one action before adding another.
Change your language, sound, look and privacy settings.
Changes the interface and requests this locale for recognition and speech.
Uses Android’s on-device recognizer when supported. No automatic network fallback.
Uses the Android speech service selected by your device. It may process audio online.
Off uses on-device mode only. On may send audio to the device provider.
The provider installed on your phone may send microphone audio to its own service. VOICE OS does not run that service. You can keep on-device mode and type instead.
Automatically read results using an installed offline voice, when available.
Pause the decorative orbit animation. Microphone levels can still be shown.
Save action results on this phone
Saves matched action, time and result only. Turning this off stops new saves; clear old entries from History.
Local commands need no account or server. The website connection and Android speech provider are optional.
You decide whether to use the microphone. Typed commands and shortcuts don’t need it.
Requested for press-to-talk only. Recording stops when you leave this app.
If Android doesn’t show a new prompt, manage access in Android app settings.
Android couldn’t open app settings. Open Apps from the Android Settings app.
VOICE OS doesn’t request contacts, camera, location, call or message access. It only opens the relevant Android screens.
A voice interface for real Android actions.
VOICE OS is a regular Android app. It uses official APIs to hand off actions to the system, rather than pretending to be the operating system.
Uses a local bilingual grammar for one command at a time. A launch reply means Android accepted the request, not that another app performed a task.
Local actions work without a server. Connecting to a website for APK releases does not sync any history or voice data.
No sending messages, making calls, scheduling, media autoplay, wake word or changing protected settings.
Connect this Android app to your VOICE OS website and check for a signed update.
Save the HTTPS address of your own VOICE OS website. No commands, audio or history are uploaded.
Enter an HTTPS address without a path, query, or account details.
Use Check for updates to contact the website.
Checking the website for an APK…
Save your website above to check for updates.
The website responded, but no signed Android APK is published there yet.
The website does not list a newer Android version.
A newer release with the same signing certificate is listed.
This update requires a newer Android version.
The published certificate differs from this install. It cannot replace this copy (including a debug copy).
Could not verify release information. Check the site address and connection, then try again.
Android could not open a browser for the link.
Downloads open in your browser. After downloading, open the file and confirm in Android. Installation is never automatic.
